section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Functional Body Appreciation Scale (FBApS), a 5-item measure of body functionality appreciation developed from qualitative interviews with first-time pregnant women. The scale uses a 5-point Likert response format, demonstrated good internal consistency (α = 0.82 in original validation, α = 0.70 in the present study), and showed significant negative associations with body surveillance, depressive symptoms, and unhealthy prenatal behaviors. This is a methodological description of a measurement instrument rather than a complete empirical study.
